features: 【Lightweight & Portable Mouse】With ultra-thin ergonomic design and smooth surface, this bluetooth mouse provides comfort in your hands. Measuring about 11.7x5.9x2.5 cm, it is lightweight, portable and ultra-space-saving, easily fitting into your laptop bag. Whether you're working during travel or at your desk, this PC wireless mouse is a must-have

【Rechargeable Mouse for Laptops】Built-in durable 500mAh lithium rechargeable battery can last up to 10 days after fully charged, and standby time is super long with auto sleep and wake mode (The mouse wireless will be in sleep mode in 10 mins of inactivity). You can easily recharge the mouse using the included USB cable, no need to change the battery. Tips: Please do not use one under any quick charger, as using a fast charger may cause product malfunction or reduced battery performance

【Dual Mode Mouse for Laptop】The laptop mouse offers an easy switch between Bluetooth 5.1 and 2.4G wireless connections, bringing stable and reliable performance. Stable connection with quick response and smooth tracking. Bluetooth cordless 5.1 ensures quick response and precise movement, while 2.4G provides plug & play convenience, no need for a driver (USB receiver stored in the bottom of the mouse)

【Silent Click Ergonomic Mouse】Featuring a classic design, silent button reduces 90% noises to meet most people's pursuit of silent bluetooth mouse. Ideal for use in offices, conference room, cafe, library and bedroom, allowing you to concentrate on your work or studies without disturbing those around you

【Color Light Sleek वायरलेस माउस】The upgraded version wireless mouse with the LED lights, 5 different color changes randomly while in use, offering soothing lighting, more fun to the boring office life. There's a switch on the LED mouse, you can turn on/off lights freely(Warm Tips: When the mouse is working, the LED STOP flashes; when the mouse is not working, the LED flashing.) Please Note: the LED light on the right side will be a little dimmer as there is a cylindrical strip of embedded battery in the right side of the mouse
